description: Turn rough workshop ideas into clear, timed SessionRun agendas. List and review your active sessions, create complete sessions, update their purpose and details, add or edit agenda blocks, and reorder the rundown. Access is securely authorized with your own SessionRun account, and the integration does not provide a session deletion tool.
